release_notes_md:
## Licensing overhaul — Phase 3 batch

This release ships the first batch of the ground-up licensing overhaul
locked in v10.36. Customer-side changes only; vendor portal split into
private creator + public verifier lands in a later release.

### What's new

**Support plan semver gate on updates** — minor and major version bumps
now require an active support plan. Patches and rollbacks remain
available regardless of SUP status. Customers see a renewal CTA on the
Updates page when their SUP is lapsed and a minor/major release is
out. Enforced in two layers: the Updates page filter excludes blocked
versions from the catalog, and the install endpoints return HTTP 403
with a structured `sup_required_for_version` body so a hand-rolled
POST still gets gated.

**Lapsed-SUP customers can add cameras within cap** — previously,
lapsed support blocked adding new cameras. Now the device cap is the
gate, not the SUP date. Perpetual licenses stay perpetual.

**Expired demo hard cutoff** — when a demo license's `expires_at`
passes, ingest workers stop processing camera events, the portal goes
read-only (35 mutation endpoints return HTTP 423 Locked), and all
camera configs are preserved. Installing a paid license immediately
resumes operation. No data is destroyed; no migration is needed.

**Dead-state license auto-purge** — rows that have been in a dead
band (wrong_system_id, expired, revoked, invalid_signature) for more
than 30 days are automatically soft-removed by a new cleanup worker
running every 6 hours. Each purge fires an `license_auto_purged`
audit log entry.

### New endpoints

* `GET /api/v1/system/license-block-status` — read-only view of the
  derived block flags (`blocks_ingest`, `blocks_writes`,
  `blocks_add_seat`). Used by the upcoming portal banner UI; available
  to any signed-in user.

### Schema

* `licenses.state_first_observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ` — new column. Stamped
  when a row enters a dead band; cleared on recovery. Drives the
  30-day cleanup grace period. Idempotent ALTER on first boot, no
  downtime.

### Internal architecture

* New `system_config[license_block_status]` JSON row published by the
  api's licensing reverify cycle. Worker containers (db-writer,
  ftp-ingest) poll this row every 60s instead of re-running the
  signature verify pipeline themselves. Fail-open if the row is
  missing or the api is down.

### Test surface

* api: 343 → 401 tests
* db-writer: 13 → 22 tests
* ftp-ingest: 7 → 15 tests
